fields.Name: C1 -> S3.1
fields.Description: Gate G1.12 (phase 1, dataset C1, criterion S3.1): 100 scenario C1 entities assembled through the training path and through the scoring path at the same as-of date give identical feature vectors, 0 mismatches of 100. It fails when the scoring path's AssembleForScoring reads current values instead of calling the as-of assembler, so mismatches appear.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 100 C1 unit rows assembled through the training path and the scoring path give identical feature vectors: 0 mismatches of 100.
